HEEWON STYLE — a premium KOREAN WEBTOON / MANHWA splash illustration of a group, lit with cinematic tenebrism. A 2:1 movie frame composed for a 2:1 letterbox crop (nothing important at the top or bottom edge). WAIST-UP GROUP SHOT of five, staggered in depth before a gate. DRAW IT EXACTLY IN THE STYLE OF THE ATTACHED CHARACTER SHEET: the same clean confident black ink linework, the same manhwa face design (eye shape, brows, nose, jaw, hairline and hair). It must read as an INKED DRAWING: visible line strokes everywhere — bold tapered contour lines around every figure, drawn fold lines in the silk and armour, hair drawn as inked strands, a little cross-hatching and line shading in the shadows — then flat cel-shading in two or three tones per colour, no airbrushed gradients. Each face must be recognisably the character drawn on the sheet, wearing the same clothes. NOT realistic, NOT an oil painting, NOT photoreal, NOT painterly, NOT a 3D render, no skin pores or photographic texture. ONLY THESE FIVE PEOPLE in the frame. THE TRAITORS: EVERY KINGDOM FELL THROUGH A DOOR OPENED FROM INSIDE. A tall heavy timber gate seen from INSIDE, its bar lifted, one sliver of cold light through the gap between the leaves cutting a vertical seam down the black. Five men stand in the dark before it, each half-lit by that seam and nothing else, none looking at another: the grain clerk Gumil with a torch lowered; Satek Chunbok bowing with a fawning smile, a letter half hidden in his sleeve; Yeon Namseng in Goguryeo armour, face turned away in shame; the monk Shinsung, palms pressed together, eyes open and calculating; Satek Sangya with his empty hands held open. CHARACTER SHEET (copy these faces, hair and clothes exactly): 1st face from the LEFT of the sheet = GUMIL; 2nd face from the LEFT of the sheet = SATEK CHUNBOK; 3rd face from the LEFT of the sheet = YEON NAMSENG; 4th face from the LEFT of the sheet = SHINSUNG; 5th face from the LEFT of the sheet = SATEK SANGYA. GUMIL — Look: Thirties, lean border officer, stubble and a thin moustache, orange-red head-wrap with trailing tails, tired angry eyes. Dress: Rust-red border-officer coat over dark trousers, navy sash, leather bracers, a plain sword at the hip (portrait-true). Colour #6b7f9e. | SATEK CHUNBOK — Crown: the great-clan gilt crown (see NOBLE CROWN), no jougwan. Colour #d4a94e. | YEON NAMSENG Colour #c25a4e. | SHINSUNG Colour #8f7b70. | SATEK SANGYA — Look: Stocky harbour lord about forty: sea-tanned skin, shrewd narrow pricing eyes, flat unimpressed mouth, clipped black beard and moustache, thick neck. Dress: Deep red wide-sleeved Satek robe with a black crossed collar under a plain grey steel lamellar vest; a dark sash with a string of square-holed bronze coins and bamboo tally slips at the hip; a rolled harbour ledger in hand. Crown: the great-clan gilt crown (see NOBLE CROWN), no jougwan. Colour #b8933f. LIGHT AND BACKGROUND (deep manhwa tenebrism, darker than a normal splash page): about TWO-THIRDS OF THE FRAME IS PURE INK-BLACK. No set, no architecture or floor beyond what the scene names, no props beyond what the characters hold. Each figure is pulled out of the black by ONE hard, narrow key light from the side or from below in THAT PERSON'S OWN COLOUR, catching only a cheekbone, an eye, the bridge of the nose, the edge of a sleeve, a plate of armour or a hand; the rest of each figure falls off into solid black shadow and merges with the background, so neighbouring figures are separated only by their coloured edge light. MOSTLY IN DARKNESS: each figure is about TWO-THIRDS BLACK SILHOUETTE; only the side of the face, shoulder, hands and robe edge turned toward that person's own light show colour and detail, the rest merges into the black. SPLIT LIGHTING ON EVERY FIGURE: the lit side of each face and body in that person's colour, the other half PURE BLACK; no even front light, no fill light, no evenly lit robes — even white silk falls to black on its shadow side. Faces readable but half in shadow, eyes catching the light (ordinary eyes — no light streaks or glow across the eyes). At most a few thin wisps of smoke tinted by those coloured lights. Deep inky blacks, crisp highlights, hard cast shadows. Each person's colour is the colour of the light on them — never a glow aura, halo or outline glow. BLOCKING, BODY LANGUAGE AND FACIAL EXPRESSIONS show who they are to each other at a glance. Faces and clothes from the sheet; new poses, never the sheet's stance. One of each person, never cloned. No text, no lettering, no speech bubbles, no panel borders, no watermark.
